what_it_does: Studies whether approximate neural network hardware remains secure against power side-channel attacks. Approximate computing cuts power consumption by using relaxed precision (overclocking without full voltage, reduced voltage, or fewer bits per operation). Tests three approximation techniques: running at higher clock speeds than rated, lowering supply voltage below design spec, and using bitwise approximation (dropping low-order computation bits). Measures how much the electrical power signature (power side-channel) leaks weight information compared to standard hardware, and compares security versus power consumption tradeoffs.
